categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: software development services for Japanese clients, focusing on financial institutions such as securities, insurance, and banking; and domestic financial software application solutions targeting China's securities market and other financial sectors. It provides customized software development, application solutions, and related services including consulting, design, development, and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, microservices architecture, and low-code/no-code development platforms. The company has proprietary development tools and platforms such as LMSP, LVB microservice framework, LinkMate low-code platform, and automated testing tools. It leverages AI models, including large language models and RAG technology, for intelligent automation in software development and financial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major Japanese financial institutions and software contractors, including Nomura Research Institute and other top-tier Japanese IT consulting firms. Domestically, the company serves over 70 securities firms, fund companies, futures companies, and asset management firms in China. The end markets are primarily financial services sectors such as securities, banking, insurance, asset management, and trust industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan and China, with subsidiaries and operations in Tokyo, Shanghai, Suzhou, and other Chinese cities. It also has entities in the British Virgin Islands and the United Kingdom. Japanese operations contribute the majority of revenue, while domestic Chinese operations focus on financial software solutions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the software development service supply chain, providing high-value software development, consulting, design, and maintenance services. It acts as a primary software development contractor and solution provider for financial institutions, integrating advanced technologies into client systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of AI, cloud computing, big data, and blockchain into financial software solutions. The company emphasizes R&D in AI-driven automation platforms, intelligent financial services, and digital transformation tools. It invests in developing proprietary platforms for automated design, coding, testing, and deployment, and focuses on expanding domestic financial software market share while maintaining strong Japanese market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through software development service contracts, including customized software development, application software sales, and ongoing maintenance services. The company also earns income from licensing proprietary platforms and tools, consulting services, and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading provider of financial software development services in Japan, recognized as a major supplier to Nomura Research Institute and other top Japanese IT firms. In China, it holds a growing position in the securities software solutions market, serving many leading securities firms. Its competitive advantages stem from deep industry expertise, advanced technology integration, and strong client relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 60% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124 million, up 44%. The company has shown steady growth driven by business expansion and acquisitions, with total assets reaching RMB 1.79 billion. R&D investment accounted for 6.18% of revenue, supporting ongoing innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its deep expertise in Japanese financial software development, advanced proprietary development platforms, and integration of cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud computing. It offers high-quality, efficient, and customized software solutions that enhance client operational efficiency and digital transformation. Its strong project management and cost control capabilities ensure reliable delivery and competitive pricing.
